The crypto market has lost more than $500 billion in 25 days. Bitcoin dropped below $61K, wiping out over $400 billion. Altcoins fell even harder.

For the crypto market, corrections like this are nothing new. But when your entire portfolio depends only on price movement, even a normal pullback can put serious pressure on your nerves. Especially when the market is falling fast, the news gets darker, and panic starts spreading across the feed again.
In moments like this, it becomes clear how important diversification really is. Not only between different assets, but also between different ways of working with them.

One of those approaches is staking.

In Sl8, you can stake USDC, ETH, BTC, XLM, SHX and other assets with attractive percentages. There is also a multi-level referral program: 6% from Level 1, 5% from Level 2, and 4% from Level 3.

The point is not to remove market risks completely. That is impossible. But staking can become an additional part of a portfolio that helps you avoid depending only on the daily movement of the chart.

While the price moves up and down, assets in staking continue to work. This gives you more space to make calm decisions and helps you avoid reacting to every red candle as if everything is already lost.

The market will continue moving in waves. Sometimes sharply, sometimes painfully. The real question is how your portfolio is structured and whether it includes tools that help you get through such periods without unnecessary panic.

Someone sells emotionally when the market has already dropped hard. Someone else uses these periods to calmly build positions and earn additional income from the assets they already have in their portfolio.

How are you protecting your portfolio from volatility right now?

🖥 Flights at Tehran’s Mehrabad Airport suspended

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Tehran’s Mehrabad Airport has suspended all incoming and outgoing flights after the renewed aggression by the Israeli regime against Iran.

The public relations office of the airport announced the suspension of all flights until further notice, saying that further related news and announcements will be published through the official channels.
​
The move followed a directive from the country’s civil aviation authority, announcing the cancellation of all flights based on safety and security assessments, leading to the closure of the airspace of the western part until further notice.

📲 @Irna_en​

⚡️ Civil Aviation Organization: Western part of Iran’s airspace closed

📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Spokesperson of the Civil Aviation Organization Majid Akhavan has announced that the western part of Iran’s airspace would be closed until further notice.

Following safety and security evaluations, and after publishing an official NOTAM, authorities have closed the western part of the country's airspace indefinitely.
​
Iran launched two waves of missiles strikes against key military positions of the Israeli regime on Sunday evening in response to the repeated violations of ceasefire by the regime.
​
Local Iranian media have cited military sources as saying that dozens of missiles were fired towards key military positions of the Zionist regime, triggering sirens in Haifa, Galilee, and central regions in occupied lands.

📲 @Irna_en​

🎙 Operation Nasr launched against Tel Nof and Nevatim air bases: IRGC

📌 Tehran, IRNA – The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) has declared the launch of Operation Nasr (Triumph) targeting key facilities at the Israeli regime’s strategic Tel Nof and Nevatim air bases, saying all combat and operational units are fully prepared for broader action on multiple fronts.

In a Monday statement, the IRGC said fighters from its Aerospace Force began the operation minutes earlier, dedicating it to those martyred during the 12-day war.
​
According to the statement, the operation was launched in response to missile attacks by the Israeli regime on several radar sites in three locations across the country.
​
The IRGC also said the speed of its response and the breadth of its target bank were among the key features of the current phase of the operation.
​
It added that all combat and operational units of the IRGC are in full readiness to carry out a large-scale deterrent and punitive operation, with plans prepared for various scenarios.
​
Despite repeated warnings from Iran against attacks on Lebanon, particularly the Hezbollah resistance movement, the Israeli regime carried out strikes on Beirut’s southern suburbs on Sunday, prompting Iran to launch retaliatory attacks on targets in the occupied territories later the same day. The Israeli regime subsequently carried out missile strikes on several locations inside Iran.

📲 @Irna_en​

New Blog Post: 20 Years on From Wall Street Warriors

Twenty years ago, a young Tim Sykes appeared on Wall Street Warriors.

He had no idea what it would set in motion.

The show was supposed to be for affluent young men. What the producers didn't know was how many viewers would reach out asking Sykes to teach them, and how that stream of aspiring traders would launch one of the most transparent trading education careers in history.

In his latest post, Sykes reflects on the 20th anniversary with the original producers, shares the full commentary video, and breaks down what has changed and what hasn't:

• Why every pattern, lesson, and trading tip he teaches today is the same as what he was doing 28 years ago, Wall Street still looks down on penny stocks, and it's still creating millionaires 📈
• Why without Wall Street Warriors, 33,000 kids around the world might not be going to Karmagawa schools today
• The one big change: he no longer short sells, and strongly advises new traders against it

Also looking ahead, the SpaceX IPO is June 12th and it's going to dominate every financial headline for the next week.

Sykes is hosting a pre-IPO briefing on June 10th, 48 hours before the IPO, including his top Supernova trade idea around the launch. 🚨
